# SIM Cards

Programs for analyzing SIM cards and working with programmable cards.

## Programs

- **[SIM Scan](./sim-scan.md)**<br/>
  Analysis of the structure of GSM SIM cards and extraction of IMSI and Ki via an RS-232 reader.
- **[SIM-EMU](./sim-emu.md)**<br/>
  SIM card emulator for programmable GreenCard and SilverCard.
